name: Aura Energy Limited
content: Aura Energy Limited is an Australian-based minerals company focused on the development of the Tiris Uranium Project in Mauritania and the Häggån Vanadium Project in Sweden. The company is transitioning from an explorer to a producer, with its flagship Tiris Project being a low-capital, low-operating-cost development located in a major emerging uranium province. Aura Energy aims to provide sustainable energy solutions through the responsible extraction of uranium and vanadium, positioning itself as a key player in the global transition toward carbon-free nuclear power and energy storage.

Officers

Andrew GroveJanuary 2024

Managing Director and CEO

Mr Grove has over 30 years of experience in the mining industry, including 22 years with Macquarie Bank in mining finance and 8 years in senior executive roles at African-focused gold producers. He has significant experience in project development, operations, and corporate finance.

Ross ArmstrongMay 2024

Chief Financial Officer

Mr Armstrong is a finance professional with over 20 years of experience in the resources sector. He has held senior financial roles in several ASX-listed companies and has extensive experience in financial management, corporate governance, and project financing.

Patrick MutzMay 2022

Non-Executive Director

Mr Mutz has over 40 years of experience in the mining industry, with a focus on uranium mining and processing. He has held senior executive roles in several uranium companies in the US and Australia.

Phil MitchellNovember 2021

Executive Chairman

Mr Mitchell has over 40 years of experience in the mining industry, including senior executive roles at Rio Tinto and Anglo American. He has extensive experience in project development, operations, and corporate strategy.

Warren Mundine2022

Non-Executive Director

Mr Mundine is a prominent Australian businessman and political figure with extensive experience in the mining and resources sector, particularly in relation to Indigenous engagement and corporate governance.
